name: aether-platform
description: Aether — Production Real-Time Voice, Chat & Ultra-HD Streaming Platform

scripts.build:native: dotnet publish apps/desktop/native-helper/AetherNativeHelper.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o apps/desktop/resources/bin
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:native && npm --workspace=@aether/desktop run build
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm --workspace=@aether/desktop run dist
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:server
